name: 66212 · Overland Park, KS
findings: ZIP 66212 (Overland Park) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66212 (Overland Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 66212 (Overland Park) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
